# Portfolio fixture

This test-only theme was scaffolded with `make new-theme` and uses the manifest from `docs/spec/examples/portfolio.json`. It lives under `tests/fixtures/themes` so it is exercised by the core integration and E2E suites without being packaged as an installable theme.

The fixture uses WordPress and core blocks, has no custom post type, and contains no external fonts or images. Its canvas page template is intended for builder pages.
